consumes.A: INTERFACE_A A.1 @b9eb6929: freeze per (horizon, fold) -> BINDING.json; evaluate subprocess stdin {config, generation, context, support, attempt}; shared receipt per fold + metadata.candidate_receipt v1
consumes.C: ASSUMED until INTERFACE_C: folds[horizon] = [{fold_id, binding:{path,sha256}}] (four 2023 quarters), weeks = [{week_id, cutoff_utc, binding:{path,sha256}, horizons:[h], eligible:bool, cause}] for the annual weekly stage, multi_output_arms = [{family: short|long, arm_id, binding:{path,sha256}}]
consumes.D: INTERFACE_D D.1 @4bedc36c: tools.i6n_archive.publisher.ArchivePublisher(...).record_candidate(candidate i6n.archive.candidate.v1, fold_receipts=[A candidate_receipt v1])
consumes.E: ASSUMED until INTERFACE_E: plan JSON {schema, plan_sha256, horizons, seed=6102026, search:{population_size<=8, generations=3, new_candidates_per_horizon=24, mutation=0.8, immigration=0.2, tolerance=1e-4, patience=3}, classes:[{class_id, max_samples, max_width, child_memory_bytes, child_wall_seconds}], minimal_seed_genome per h, prior_mapping:[{genotype_canonical_sha256, fold, receipt:{path,sha256}, verdict: EQUIVALENT|NOT_EQUIVALENT}]}; genome transport stays i6n-shared-deap-v1 wire (schema/genome/identity/context/generation) until E publishes v2

identities.fit_id: sha256(canonical {experiment, fold, effective_config_sha256, context_sha256, support_sha256}); one physical fit unit; plan independent so verified terminals are reused across plans/nodes/directories
identities.fencing_token: globally monotonic integer issued by the ledger per claim; passed to A as attempt.fencing_token (string)

ledger.storage: <campaign-root>/state/ledger.sqlite3 (WAL), single authority on the coordinator; workers reach it through tools.i6n_swarm.lease_service (HTTP JSON, bearer token from a private file)
ledger.claim: claim(fit_id, owner, host, boot_id, device_class, ttl_seconds) -> {result: CLAIMED|ADOPT|HELD|WAIT_RESOURCE|REFUSED, token, attempt:{index, kind: INITIAL|RESUME|RECOVERY, parent_attempt, parent_status_sha256}, terminal, cause}
ledger.renew: renew(fit_id, token, progress) -> bool; false means the holder must self-fence (kill its child) before the lease expires
ledger.complete: complete(fit_id, token, receipt) -> ACCEPTED|ALREADY|DUPLICATE_DISCARDED; receipt identity must equal the unit (fold, effective_config_sha256, genotype); first verified terminal wins, a late verified receipt of the same fit_id is adopted and supersedes a running recovery
ledger.recover: recover(host, boot_id) at boot: RUNNING attempts of a previous boot or with an expired lease -> INTERRUPTED
ledger.policy: max 3 physical attempts per fit_id; at most one RECOVERY attempt (no checkpoint) linked to its parent; RESUME only with a complete checkpoint (optimizer, rng, epoch, stopping); OOM/timeout/evaluator refusal are terminal FAILED, never retried with a lower cap

evaluation.doin_wrapper: doin_plugins.predictor.optimizer.PredictorOptimizer with optimization_config.i6n_swarm (shared-only, no predictor/preprocessor/target imports, no default_optimizer fallback)
evaluation.evaluator_callable: tools.i6n_swarm.bridge:evaluate (runs in the node executor thread; launches one crispdm-run admitted subprocess per fold; no SIGALRM, no CPU fallback)
evaluation.node_environment: I6N_SWARM_NODE_CONFIG=<private node json> (ledger url/token file, owner, host key, boot id source, device, crispdm-run path, caps)
evaluation.fold_aggregation: fitness = unweighted mean over all plan folds of tools.i6n_search._score(fold receipt, fold support); a candidate with any non-COMPLETE fold has no fitness
evaluation.result_binding: result.candidate_identity == wire.identity and result.hyper_dict == effective_config(wire.genome); the node refuses a peer result whose candidate_identity differs from its population entry

stages: multi_output(family) after annual_weekly(h) COMPLETE for every h of the family
dag.activation: coordinator tick (systemd timer) activates successors; a localized failure blocks only its dependants

status.fields: {state, cause, counts:{expected, complete, failed, interrupted, running, queued}, eta:{kind: measured|projected|unknown, seconds, low, high, basis_n}, lease:{owner_host_key, boot_id, token, expires_at}}
status.eta_rule: only measured production fit durations of the same class feed ETA; fixture/test units are excluded

publication: collect calls D record_candidate once per terminal candidate disposition (COMPLETE, FAILED, INTERRUPTED, NOT_ADMITTED) with seed 6102026 and the A fold receipts; local outbox survives D outages
